verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies incident roles exist: Ask Rootly AI is grounded in an incident's "roles" [rootly-docs-53], and summaries draw on "action items" [rootly-docs-20]. Coordinated, repeatable response is suggested by the workflow engine and "the same way every time" automation [rootly-docs-16, rootly-docs-34], but no doc describes defining commander/comms-lead roles or task checklists. missing for 10: explicit documentation of configurable incident roles (commander, comms lead) and role assignment, documented task/checklist features tied to incidents or roles, independent or hands-on corroboration.
